upload.title: Import bank CSV
upload.intro: Export the transactions of one account from NAB internet banking as CSV and choose the file here. Nothing reaches your month until you review and confirm it.
upload.accountTitle: Which account is this file from?
upload.hint: A CSV file up to 2 MB.

several.title: This file has {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}
several.body: Review each account’s movements on its own.

nothingNew.title: Nothing new in this file
nothingNew.body: Every movement in it was imported before.

problem.notCsv: This is not a CSV file. Export the transactions as CSV from your bank.
problem.tooLarge: This file is over 2 MB. Export a shorter period.
problem.limit: Your plan’s imports for this month are used up.
problem.batchOpen: This account already has an import waiting for review. Confirm or cancel it first.

csv.E_CSV_TOO_LARGE: This file is over 2 MB. Export a shorter period.
csv.E_CSV_TOO_MANY_ROWS: This file has too many rows. Export a shorter period.
csv.E_CSV_ENCODING: This file’s text encoding cannot be read. Export it again as CSV.
csv.E_CSV_UNKNOWN_FORMAT: This does not look like a NAB export. Export the transactions as CSV from NAB internet banking.
csv.E_CSV_MALFORMED: This file is damaged and cannot be read.
csv.E_CSV_INVALID_VALUE: A value in this file cannot be read.

mapping.title: Which account is each number?
mapping.body: These bank account numbers are new here. Choose the account each one belongs to; it is remembered for next time.

review.title: Review import
review.classifying: Classifying {count, plural, one {# movement} other {# movements}}

error.title: The import could not be loaded.

closed.title: This import is closed.
closed.body: It was confirmed or cancelled. Import a new file to keep going.

empty.title: Nothing to show here.
empty.body: No movement of this import matches this filter.

review.blocking: {count, plural, one {# movement needs a decision before you confirm.} other {# movements need a decision before you confirm.}}

cancelSheet.title: Cancel this import?
cancelSheet.body: The movements waiting for review are dropped. Nothing changes in your month, and you can import the same file again.

triage.title: Review movement
triage.create: Add it as a new movement
triage.learnHint: Next imports sort it the same way.
triage.private: This is your partner’s private movement.
triage.nothing: There is nothing to decide for this movement.

reason.possible_match: It may be a movement you already added.
reason.transfer_destination_unknown: It looks like a transfer, but the other account is unknown.
reason.transfer_destination_guessed: The other account is a guess: it is the only one it could be. Check it.
reason.future_date: It is dated in the future.

split.title: Split {amount}
split.missingCategory: Choose a category for every line.

result.title: Import confirmed
result.headline: {count, plural, one {new movement added} other {new movements added}}
result.missing: {amount} away from the bank’s balance. Movements before {date} are missing: import an older export to fill the gap.
result.unknown: There was no bank balance to compare with.
result.error: The result could not be loaded.

toast.bulkDone: {count, plural, one {# movement updated.} other {# movements updated.}}
toast.classifyRunning: The AI is already classifying this import.
toast.undecided: Some movements still need a decision.
toast.quota: The AI allowance of your plan is used up this month.
